summary: B1 supports only that the unseen-work term changed same-snapshot assignments on 8/8 observed questions. All trees hit the node cap; answer coverage was 3/8 per arm and exact match 1/8 per arm. No predictor generalization or causal latency benefit is established.

gt_provenance.details: GSM8K dataset answers are loaded only for offline scoring; prompts contain no gold answer. Evaluation is custom majority-of-terminal-JSON exact match, not the official GSM8K pipeline.

score_normalization.details: Reported exact-match counts and latency are raw. Predictor RMSE is in-sample on 32 observations from four budget-capped calibration trees; there is no held-out accuracy evidence.

result_existence.details: Raw events, configs, summaries, comparisons, and logs exist and reconcile. tree_completed means queues drained, including budget-pruned trees; the B1 gate does not test natural stopping, answer availability, quality, predictor accuracy, or causal latency.

dead_code.details: Reported parsing, aggregation, telemetry, and calibration metrics are exercised. Several ordering/failure invariants are fixture-only and are not automatically asserted by the live runner.

scope.details: One model, one dataset split, four calibration questions, eight test questions, and one run per arm. Questions ran sequentially; p95 is the maximum. Cache/order confounding and missing scheduler CPU timing prevent performance attribution.

claims.scope: The term changed at least one same-state assignment on 8/8 observed questions.
Live model requests exercised expansion and pruning under a 9-node cap, but all corrected trees saturated that cap.
